resources.string: Handle short Home presses directly to avoid briefly showing the original home; hold Home for Google voice search. Other remote buttons pass through. Open Mountain TV when the original TV home appears if the TV does not deliver Home keys. After you click Bluetooth, inspect only the TV Settings menu for up to eight seconds and select Remotes & Accessories once. Other apps are not inspected. No screen content is stored or sent, and key events are not stored or sent. Gestures and screenshots are not captured. The small dot pauses home redirection; open Mountain TV from Apps to resume.
